# B&A Insurance Producers

> B&A Insurance Producers (Bowthorpe & Associates) is a family-owned, independent "Trusted Choice" insurance agency in Bountiful, Utah, serving Utah families and businesses since the early 1980s. As an independent agency, we compare policies from 20+ top-rated carriers to find clients the right personal, business, or health coverage — we represent the client, not any single insurance company.

Key facts:

- Founded by Dennis Bowthorpe in the early 1980s; owned and operated by his daughter Sharie and her spouse George since 2005
- Office: 1075 S. 500 W., Ste. 100, Bountiful, UT 84010
- Hours: Mon–Thu 8:30am–4:30pm, Fri 8:30am–3:00pm, closed weekends
- Phone: (801) 487-2300 · Email: info@bowthorpeinsurance.com
- Serves all of Utah, including Bountiful, Salt Lake City, Ogden, and Provo; remote service by phone and email
- Quotes and guidance are free; agents are compensated by carriers, never by clients

## Services

- [Personal Insurance](https://bowthorpeinsurance.com/personal/): home, auto, umbrella, motorcycle, boat, RV, ATV, and life insurance
- [Business Insurance](https://bowthorpeinsurance.com/business/): general liability, commercial property, commercial auto, workers' compensation, professional liability (E&O), surety bonds, cyber liability, and specialty/surplus markets
- [Health Insurance](https://bowthorpeinsurance.com/health/): individual and group health plans, Medicare Supplement, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, and life insurance
